long_biography.plain_text:
Harout Ohanesian chairs Harwal Group, whose current portfolio grew from a business established in 1938. Earlier, he served as both chairman and chief executive of a management holding built around plastic, wood and metal manufacturing. The group now separates his chairmanship from day-to-day executive management.

His work was not confined to governance. Ohanesian invented an extrusion system that reshaped plastic tubing for shutter assemblies, with the resulting patent rights assigned to Harwal member US Polymers. His designs also covered shutter hardware and storage-shed components. US Polymers now produces building materials, custom profiles, shutters and storage systems.
